EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
My No.: W/L/4/L A/17. Land Ministry’s No.: 4/3/9/2012/I /R/32.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Schedule 01 Allotments of Land in F. V. P. 524, Suppliment No. 7, Sheet No. 8 prepared by the superintend surveyor in Monaragala, Situated in Heenapahuwa Village in the Wellawaya Divisional Secretary’s Division of the District of Monaragala In Uva province described as follows.
